reading.title: Discord ordered to suspend livestreams in Brazil
reading.summary: Discord told the BBC it was "thoughtfully reviewing" the order by Brazil's data protection agency and it was "committed to user safety"

news.title: Under strain, Australia's world-leading disability support faces major restructure
news.summary: The NDIS was game-changing for its users - but as costs balloon, its success has led to its downfall.
